issues.title: Poll/cancel race recreates cleaned limiter key
issues.details: quickConnectStatus calls get(), then AllowWith(), then beginPoll(). If cancel or prune removes the flow between those calls, beginPoll returns nil but the newly allocated quick_connect_poll:<idHash> entry remains. Repeated concurrent abandon/poll races grow limiter memory. Delete on the nil path and test concurrency.
